class.name: Porion.Queries.Node_Stat
class.comment: Statistics about the usage of a build node.

property.name: test_duration
property.comment: the total duration of all tests.

query.name: stat-nodes
query.comment: Statistics about the usage of the build node over time
query.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', build.create_date) AS date, build.status AS status, COUNT(build.id) AS cnt, SUM(build.test_duration) AS test_duration, SUM(build.build_duration) AS build_duration, SUM(build.sys_time) AS sys_time, SUM(build.user_time) AS user_time FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.node_id = :node_id GROUP BY date, build.status

query.name: stat-project-nodes
query.comment: Statistics about the usage of the all build nodes over time for a given project
query.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', build.create_date) AS date, build.status AS status, COUNT(build.id) AS cnt, SUM(build.test_duration) AS test_duration, SUM(build.build_duration) AS build_duration, SUM(build.sys_time) AS sys_time, SUM(build.user_time) AS user_time FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY date, build.status

query.name: stat-all-nodes
query.comment: Statistics about the usage of the all build nodes over time
query.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', build.create_date) AS date, build.status AS status, COUNT(build.id) AS cnt, SUM(build.test_duration) AS test_duration, SUM(build.build_duration) AS build_duration, SUM(build.sys_time) AS sys_time, SUM(build.user_time) AS user_time FROM porion_build AS build GROUP BY date, build.status
